subject: Install the shiny package versions in shinyapps.io

messages.author: c64c855afdc4e377
messages.subject: Install the shiny package versions in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I have deployed shinyapp in shinyapps.io.  Later in my dev environment (using EC2), I updated certain R packages causing issues in the app in the dev environment. I am unable to restore the original versions of those packages as some of them were basically the devtool versions of the packages which would have undergone changes by now.  How can I use the downloaded app package from shinyapps.io and use those packages back in my dev environment.  

Long story short, similar to how I deploy a shinyapp in dev version (RStudio) directly onto shinyapps.io,  can I do the reverse so that the deployed shinyapps.io version of the app replaces my current dev version? 

Thank you
SD

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Install the shiny package versions in shinyapps.io
parts:
Sushanta,
You may be able to piece this together again, the thing to do is to download the application bundle from shinyapps.io and look at the manifest.json file which contains all the backages you were using the version of the package.  It also lets you know which version of R you were using  

Best of luck,
Tareef
